reviews.text:
Fantastic service, training, communication & guidance. We have had both in home training and boarding over the holidays and really appreciate the flexibility afforded to us.

Moose can be a handful but he loves James!

James gave us daily pictures and videos of Moose, updates on how he did throughout the days, advice to help with his ongoing training and summaries after each visit. He even picked up and brought him back to our house.

Awesome to have a service that we can trust and that our dog enjoys. As long as James will take/work with Moose, not using anyone else.

I cannot recommend working with James enough. He went above and beyond with our puppy and has an amazing gift in working with animals. He was willing to drive to our home for the sessions and did way more than was expected to make sure our puppy was improving beyond what we expected. He gave us so many tools to work with her on going forward and saw massive improvement in how we worked with her. Our relationship with our dog was totally changed and more importantly, our doggy LOVED working with James! I'm sure yours will too and highly recommend James for anything you need with your animals. Amazing value. We now consider James part of our team/family and learned SO much from him. Thanks James!

James and Erika are amazing! They cared for our puppy like their own. With their help, she learned basic obedience, and most importantly, thanks to their magic touch, she completely stopped chewing on shoes! 😊 The early exposure to other dogs built her confidence and made such a difference!
Their home feels more like leaving her with friends than a boarding facility, and James has a special way of connecting with dogs that is remarkable.
We cannot thank them enough for the love, patience, and care they gave her.
We are so grateful and highly recommend them!

Koen not only works with your dog but also with you. He was able to guide us on how to be consistent in our message and enable us to see our bad patterns. His training has provided a good solid structure for our rescue.  We are happy and grateful for the training he was able to provide for Houston.
James is so awesome with our dog! We saw such great improvement throughout our training sessions. He was very flexible and easy to work with. Would highly recommend him to anyone!

Our family loves Good Vibes Dog Training.  We are always at peace knowing that our dogs are happy and taken care of.  James and Erika are so caring and our dogs are always happy to see them again.  Thanks for the great service!
Clay is awesome. So grateful to have a place to bring my needy little guy when he could get all the attention he needed. Thank you.

We’ve been clients of Good Vibes Dog Training for the past 1.5 years, and can’t say enough good things about James. He always takes the absolute best care of both of our very different, sometimes very quirky dogs :). We’ve used him consistently for dog boarding while we travel, and that peace of mind knowing the pups are safe and having fun is just priceless. James is great at keeping us up to date with photos and videos, and the logistics around all of it is a breeze. We’ve also used Good Vibes for dog walking during the long workdays when we can’t be home, which has been really helpful. And, we’ve also done some training with James for our pup Archie. That’s made a big difference! James is empathetic, reliable, and just extremely kind — exactly the kind of person you want with your fur babies. 10/10 recommend!!
James is a top notch trainer and has been a huge help to us. He loves my dog Sandy and she’s always delighted to spend time with him. Five stars all around.

James provided great training and boarding for my pet Hercules.  He would send videos each day of Hercules and Edgar playing around in the baseball field.    If you need someone to take care of your pet while you are out of town and need some brush up on obedience Good Vibes is the place to be.

It's all good at Good Vibes.  Our pup has an excellent time hanging out with James and the other dogs.  All dogs are well taken care of and have ample room to run and play.  They're thorough as well, making sure all dogs are compatible and vaccinated.  James is a pro with a great operation.

Our dog Pinto Bean has done both training and boarding with James. I love that he gets to be in a home environment while we’re gone, it’s such a peace of mind! Pinto is nervous around strangers sometimes but he quickly warmed up to James and we have also learned some ways to make him more confident!
James was very easy to work with and handled our dogs very well. The dogs also took to him very quickly and looked forward to his visits. I highly recommend him!

Lincoln is a 9mo male boxer puppy so you can see we are challenged from the very beginning 😂 James was recommended to us by a highly touted walking service and  gladly stepped in to help us reign in some of Lincoln’s craziness (at least manners wise) not so much  take away the silly goofy clowns all boxers are known to be. The fact that James not just loves all dogs but was a special affinity for boxers (as an owner and trainer)  has helped tremendously. Whenever Lincoln stays with him, he works diligently with Lincoln on how to be a NICER goofy silly clown. James and his partner are wonderful human beings; live in a lovely home; a good neighborhood making the one the greatest things that could’ve ever happened to Lincoln. Not only does he do “work” with Lincoln but Lincoln also gets to play with James’s other dogs too! THANKS James!

James has been a great help with our older dog! We have seen drastic improvements in his behavior in just a few lessons. We couldn’t be happier with the results we have seen. 10/10, 5 stars would recommend!
The dogs love James. He is caring and conscientious. We are confident leaving our dogs in his care.
James provided a safe and comfortable environment for my baby girls.  I love that they were kept company, well-fed, and taken on walks.  I loved receiving multiple daily pics, too!

James is a great dog trainer who I trust to be very loving and kind with my dog. He is really responsive and communicative and meets the dog where they’re at. He doesn’t try to change your routine and impose something that might be unrealistic. Just a great guy who really does love dogs!

James provides exceptional dog training. We have two miniature sheepadoodles that are very hyper and overwhelming when people come over to our house. After just one hour with James, we learned just how eager our dogs were to learn and have completely changed the way they behave when someone comes over. One of our dogs was a severe leash puller, but James has also corrected that behavior.

James’ compassionate and communication driven approach to training has completely changed the way we think about training and our relationship with our dogs. His approach is all about patience, care, and accountability – an approach that really resonated with us and has been extremely effective.

On top of the incredible training he provides, he also boards our dogs. He sends us plenty of updates and pictures so we always know how our dogs are doing. Both our dogs have different personalities and he even takes the time to do what each of them like (park and running for one, lazy evenings in for the other!) We’re very grateful to have found James and couldn’t recommend him enough!

James is the best! We were a little hesitant at first as our dog has not been the best when around other dogs, but he assured us things would be fine...and he was 100% correct! Not only were they fine, she seemed to have a great time :) And …
